title: ADR-00 Topology, tick barrier and determinism
outcome: Process topology (gateway, witness, one subprocess per agent, signer handles, sockets) and the gateway-as-scheduler tick barrier that makes seeded runs reproducible; due 24 Nov
acceptance: ADR file ≤900 words with sections Context, Decision, Consequences, Interface touched (which of C1–C6), Tests that prove it
Decision specifies the tick barrier: one envelope or no-op per agent per tick, executed in agent_id order, gateway assigns seq/ts/record_id
Names the determinism tests: same seed twice → byte-identical records; faulty run == S* before t0
States the key-isolation claim verbatim: enforced in production (uid/container), detected here by reconciliation
